Intel Core i5-14600K.description: Processor 14-core, 20 threads, 3.5 GHz (TDP 181 W), Turboboost 5.3 GHz, Boost 5.3 GHz, 24 MB L3 cache, Intel UHD Graphics 770, Intel socket 1700, Raptor Lake Refresh, without cooler
descriptions: Modern 14-core Intel Core i5-14600K Raptor Lake Refresh processor

Do you want to indulge in excellent gaming performance? In that case, take advantage of the completely new architecture of Intel Raptor Lake processors. This is the 14th generation of Intel Core chips, which is developed in all directions. The innovative approach is that the Intel Core i5-14600K CPU uses a combination of 6 powerful cores (designed for demanding applications and games) with 8 efficient cores (for multitasking). Thanks to this, it is closer to the more powerful i7 model than ever before.

Please note that Intel Raptor Lake Refresh processors are supported in boards with the Intel 600 series chipset. However, you will get maximum performance when using the latest Intel 700 series chipset. In some cases, it will be necessary to update the motherboard firmware (BIOS) to the current version.
Intel Core i5-14600K runs up to 5.3 GHz

The modern Core i5-14600KF processor will offer a base clock of 6 powerful cores at 3.5 GHz. Depending on the load increase, the frequency will then soar to 5.3 GHz, which will be particularly beneficial in gaming or when processing up to 8K HDR video at 60 FPS.
Hybrid architecture

The 14th generation of Intel Core processors focuses on powerful and efficient cores. Compared to the 13th generation, the operating frequency, L3 Cache capacity and in some cases more cores will be available. Therefore, performance is once again increasing while consumption is maintained.
Intel Thread Director

To ensure that the demands on the large and small cores of the Core i5-14600K processor are always optimally distributed, Intel had to develop a special hardware scheduler, Thread Director. Thanks to close cooperation with Microsoft, Windows 11 will become the best environment for gaming, entertainment, or creative work.
14th Gen Intel Core Processors Support Both DDR5 and DDR4
The new Intel Raptor Lake Refresh processor is compatible with motherboards with the new DDR5 interface as well as DDR4, so you can choose the option that suits you best.
Key benefits of the Intel Core i5-14600K CPU

• Powerful processor designed for more demanding users
  • Operating frequency up to 5.3 GHz
  • Big performance boost in both single-threaded and multi-threaded computing
  • Compatible with LGA 1700 socket and Intel 600 series motherboards + full performance with Intel 700
  • Increased L3 Cache capacity
  • Thanks to the unlocked multiplier, the processor can be overclocked
  • Support for DDR5, DDR4 or WiFi 7 memory
  • PCIe 5.0 interface

Intel Core i9-14900F processor and overclocking

The CPU works efficiently with consumption and utilization using automatic overclocking. If the load increases, it will automatically increase the speed to a maximum of 6 GHz. However, it is important to consider the possibility of increasing the TDP, which for the Intel Core i9-14900F reaches 219 W. This processor is equipped with an original cooler, which may not be enough for higher temperatures. When overclocking, it is necessary to carefully select another, properly powerful cooling.
